note: Independent, optimization-only Validation suite for OLMo-3.1. The current Task uses a local CSV of 2,302 Level 5 MATH-Hard train problems; two source rows with empty boxed reference answers were excluded. GSM8K remains declared for historical Tasks. ARC Challenge, OpenBookQA, and WildJailbreak use their full declared splits. WildJailbreak replaces BeaverTails-Evaluation because its benign/harmful labels can be compared to model-judged response outcomes, whereas BeaverTails-Evaluation's category/category_id cannot. CodeContests is capped at 500 rows. Dolly uses the first 500 train rows with its one AlpacaEval 2 overlap ('What is the meaning of life?') removed, leaving 499 pinned rows. Instruction following uses 500 pinned, independently sampled multi-constraint rows from AllenAI's IF source with official deterministic verifiers. Test benchmarks remain 100% held out.
